messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning for this year's annual product planning. Proposing a hybrid format: async pre-reads + one condensed in-person day (4h) + follow-up async decision window (48h). Need to lock date, owners, and the facilitation rota by EOD Fri.

maria: Love the hybrid call. Quick Q: why 4h in-person? curious about session goals.

alex: Goal is to avoid full multi-day context switching. Use async to align strategy and diagnostics, then the 4h is for: final prioritization, scope negotiation, and committing launch criteria.

jonah: Works for infra constraints. Can we run a morning deep-dive (90m) + 15m break + prioritization (2h) + 15m wrap?

sarah: That schedule looks good. If we start at 10a it helps for timezone overlap. :earth_americas:

alex: Noted. Time options poll: Tue May 6, Wed May 7, Fri May 9. Vote with emoji on the doc: https://docs.redwood/prod/planning/2026 (please only the poll table).

kai: I can facilitate prioritization exercise if we use the RICE-lite matrix. I can also prep a quick template for scope negotiation.

maria: +1 to RICE-lite. Also we should have explicit customer-driven asks triage — proposed tags: "enterprise", "plumbing", "UX-critical", "regulatory".

jonah: Can someone own the launch-criteria checklist? I can pair with PMs but need a single arbiter for final wording (auditable).

alex: Assigning: sarah -> facilitation lead, kai -> prioritization workshop lead, jonah -> launch criteria editor, maria -> customer-asks triage owner. If anyone can't, ping now.

sarah: I can own facilitation, will draft a run-of-show and a facilitator notes template.

kai: Draft of scope-negotiation play snippet (will post full doc):

```
Scope negotiation play (5m per item):
- Owner states intended scope
- Stakeholders call out must-haves vs nice-to-have
- Impact estimate (low/med/high)
- Landing zone: MUST for initial launch or follow-up
- Decision: commit / defer / unblock-better-info
```

maria: Nice. For customer asks triage, I'll surface top 8 by ARR impact + severity in pre-reads.

offsite-bot: Reminder: upload pre-reads by Tue Apr 28 to the shared folder or they'll be excluded from the async digest.

alex: Pre-reads guidance (short): 1 page problem statement, 1 page data (usage/ARR/bugs), proposed launch criteria, suggested fallback. Keep to 2 pages. We'll attach to the OKR mapping matrix.

jonah: For the OKR mapping matrix, propose columns: Initiative, Owner, Success metric, Signal to launch, Dependencies, Risk. I'll scaffold a Google Sheet unless someone prefers Notion.

sarah: Google Sheet is fine. I'll add facilitator columns and timeboxed agenda slots.

kai: Last thing — please declare any immovable travel restrictions by Thu so we can pick a date that works for everyone needing in-person.

alex: Thanks all. Action items: vote on date in the doc, owners confirmed above, pre-reads due Apr 28, jonah to scaffold OKR sheet, sarah to post run-of-show by Mon. I'll compile a one-page facilitation cheat-sheet. :rocket:

maria: :thumbsup:

jonah: On it.

sarah: Will share run-of-show draft in #product-docs and ping here when up.

alex: Closing the loop — if you want to add agenda items specifically about "quality/regression alerts tied to prompt sets/evals" or "cost controls (batching/quant)" comment in the doc under the "tech ops" bucket.

maria: Adding two items now.

alex: Great. We'll reconvene for a final alignment sync Tue Apr 30 9a PT. If anything changes, call it out here.
